channel.title: The Shawnee News-Star - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Shawnee News-Star (news-star.com)

item.title: Valentine's Day Dance set at St. Benedict Church
item.description: The Marriage Encounter Ministry of St. Benedict Catholic Church will be sponsoring a Valentine’s Day dance on Saturday, Feb 14, between 7 and 11 p.m.

item.title: School day fun: SECC
item.description: After a few snow days at home last week, the district's littlest Wolves had a great first day back at Shawnee Early Childhood Center.

item.title: What the Chamber of Commerce side of Shawnee Forward looks like in action
item.description: In a recent column, I shared how Shawnee Forward serves our community in two connected ways: as the area Chamber of Commerce and as a regional economic development organization. While those roles overlap in important ways, each also has a distinct purpose.

item.title: High school student mentors young Wolves
item.description: High school students often engage with younger Wolves, and their mentorship and leadership provides a great model for students to look up to. Ryan visited Will Rogers Elementary School recently.

item.title: Arvest Bank warns about romance scams
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Valentine’s Day is coming up, making it an ideal time for fraudsters to seek out potential romance scam victims. Arvest Bank is sharing tips to help the public identify and avoid online romance scams, including what you can do if you’ve already fallen victim.

item.title: CVEC sends team to assist after Winter Storm Fern
item.description: Early Wednesday, Canadian Valley Electric Cooperative (CVEC) dispatched a dedicated team to Mississippi to assist Tallahatchie Valley Electric Power Association in restoring power following the winter storm. This action exemplifies one of the core Cooperative Principles, Cooperation Among Cooperatives, demonstrating how electric cooperatives support one another in times of need.

item.title: Firefighter recruits train in vehicle stabilization, roof access
item.description: Whether it’s 20 degrees out or 100, the mission of the Shawnee Fire Department doesn't change. With snow still on the ground, the department's latest academy class spent the day practicing vehicle stabilization and roof access.

item.title: Lady Wolves clip Comets to improve to 14-3 on season
item.description: The Shawnee Lady Wolves proved that they can make up for poor shooting by excelling in other areas to capture a victory.

item.title: Sheriff's Office issues scam alert
item.description: The Pottawatomie County Sheriff’s Office has been made aware of a jury duty scam currently targeting residents in the area. Scammers are calling citizens and falsely identifying themselves as a Deputy or law enforcement officer, claiming the person has an active warrant for missing jury duty.
